name: The Ashen Ledger: Frontier of the Toll
author: Antigravity & Original Dark Fantasy Designer
description: An expansive original dark fantasy RPG spanning 7 regions, 36 interconnected locations, 27 reactive NPCs, 10 competing factions, 23 quests (a 4-arc main story, a 3-part Artisan Crafting quest line, 8 exploration side quests, 4 morality-exclusive branches, and 4 hidden missions), 19 creatures, 118 items, 20 materials, 6 professions, 34 concealed crafting forms, 12 field combinations, and 10 campaign spells integrated into the global magic engine.
startingJournalNotes: You awoke on the rain-slick timber of the Ferry-Weir Quay with a fractured brass soul-tally in your coat. Above the misty docks rise the smoke-stacks of the Chancery of Scales, where even the dead pay interest on their breath.

easy.label: Quiet Passage (Easy)
easy.desc: Unlimited returns to the Weir-Port Bellhouse. Nothing is lost upon defeat.

normal.label: Unstamped Wayfarer (Normal)
normal.desc: Unlimited returns; falling in battle costs 10 toll-coins and a quarter of unequipped supplies.

hard.label: Cinder Debt (3 Lives)
hard.desc: Three returns to the Bellhouse before your ledger closes permanently.

extreme.label: Final Audit (One Life)
extreme.desc: Permadeath. One fatal defeat erases your name from the Threshold forever.

timeOfDayNarration.Morning: A pale brass haze filters through the chimney-smog of Vesper-Threshold as shift-bells clang across the quays.
timeOfDayNarration.Afternoon: Low amber daylight glints off wet slate and distant salt-flats while furnace bellows drone without pause.
timeOfDayNarration.Dusk: Dusk bleeds violet across the Mist-Weir; tallow-lanterns ignite one by one along the Lantern-Wall.
timeOfDayNarration.Night: Deep night blankets the Threshold. Cold salt-winds carry distant bell-chimes and whispers from the Pale Reach.

factions.name: The Chancery of Scales
factions.description: The centuries-old afterlife bureaucracy that taxes memory and distills spiritual ash to keep Vesper-Threshold lit, ordered, and subservient.

factions.name: The Quiet Reformers
factions.description: Principled clerks, archivists, and junior magistrates working inside the Chancery to abolish debt-forfeiture and restore humane crossing rites.

factions.name: The Furnace Guild
factions.description: Industrial alchemists and kiln-barons who refine Aether-Ash into fuel for lamps, engines, and the patricians' life-prolonging tonics.

factions.name: The Oar-Keepers' Union
factions.description: Stoic river wardens who ferry arrivals across the Mist-Weir and quietly preserve the older, pre-Chancery oaths of passage.

factions.name: The Unstamped Freebooters
factions.description: Frontier runners and dockside fixers who smuggle unregistered arrivals, untaxed memories, and contraband relics past the Lantern-Wall.

factions.name: The Order of the Last Bell
factions.description: Monastic bronze-casters who believe true quiet is a birthright of the dead and toll consecrated bells to ease tormented spirits.

factions.name: The Pale Frontier Wardens
factions.description: Grim border rangers stationed along the Viaduct and Lantern-Wall who hold back encroaching salt-horrors while questioning their superiors' orders.

factions.name: The Court of the Unwritten
factions.description: A proud coalition of exiles and altered souls cast beyond the Lantern-Line who forged a strange, harsh sovereignty among the salt-ruins.

factions.name: The Mnemonic Collegium
factions.description: Scholars and glassblowers who preserve bottled memories and study the shattered pre-Chancery seals without bowing wholly to the Auditors.

factions.name: The Black-Ledger Brokers
factions.description: Merciless debt-traffickers and private bailiffs who buy delinquent soul-tallies at auction and extract profit from desperation.
